{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Floor-length gown, A-line, sleeveless with a softly structured V-neckline, sage green (#9CAF88), crepe-backed satin with a matte finish
Pashmina-weight shawl, lightweight, draped over the shoulders, ivory (#F3EBDD), fine silk-modal blend
Strappy heeled sandals, block heel, slim ankle strap, nude champagne (#D9BFA0), soft leather
Clutch bag, small envelope shape, gold-tone (#C8A96A), metallic leather
Drop earrings, small and delicate, pearl with a gold setting (#E8DFC8 and #C8A96A), freshwater pearl and gold-plated metal

This outfit works because the floor-length cut and the satin fabric meet the formal dress band, while the sleeveless, airy silhouette keeps her comfortable in an August outdoor ceremony. Sage green is soft and celebratory without competing with the bride, and it looks lovely in the afternoon daylight at 16:00. The block heel stays steady on grass or gravel outdoors and still looks polished at the restaurant. The light shawl is there for evening cooling and for photographs, and the gold and pearl accents pull the look together without going overboard."}
